scope.summary: Bind 14.8 color onto the native ColorEngine (MT-019) behind ColorEngine: Send+Sync: the color transform/CMM, ICC and OCIO handling, gamut mapping, and separation math are owned by studio-engine; Studio MUST NOT depend on a platform CMM or subscription color service ([STU-OVR-002]). Transforms are deterministic given identical profiles and intents (promotion-equivalence requirement of 14.24). Adds the determinism + no-external-CMM guard tests.
acceptance_criteria: color bound to native ColorEngine; deterministic transforms; zero platform/subscription CMM dep
expected_tests: live: identical profiles+intent yield byte-identical transform across hosts
test: no platform CMM / subscription color service dependency in engine graph

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Non-deterministic or platform-bound color breaks promotion-equivalence + local-first mandate.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
